mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that boosts equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during easing periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rate above 5% triggers a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as higher unemployment reduces consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both increase, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals reduced supply chain activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during tightening periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) is increasing and housing starts (HOUST) are above 1,200,000, it signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) both signal reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
